tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/version-scheme.md <<'EOF'
# Version numbering scheme

This project uses Semantic Versioning (semver) for its version numbers. The recorded reasoning is that API compatibility matters far more to this project than publication dates, so version numbers are meant to communicate compatibility rather than when a release was published.
EOF
cat docs/policies/version-scheme.md
